config.description: Set to "1" to enable the write_memory tool. Disabled by default for safety.

config.description: host[:port] of a remote frida-server to add as a remote device at startup (port defaults to 27042).

config.label: Tool schema profile
config.description: Tool schema profile. "compact" shortens tool schemas and descriptions for clients with small context windows.

config.label: Maximum number of characters in a single tool response; longer output is truncated
config.description: Maximum number of characters in a single tool response; longer output is truncated.

config.label: Bearer token required by HTTP clients
config.description: Bearer token required by HTTP clients. Only used with --transport http (required when --host is not loopback); unused for the default stdio transport.

config.label: Frida script runtime to use for injected agents
config.description: Frida script runtime to use for injected agents.

config.description: Set to "1" to enable debug logging on stderr. Can also be set with --debug.

config.description: Directory with prebuilt Java/ObjC bridge bundles (defaults to dist/bridges inside the package)
